source.waller_definition: to be saved,to be rescued,to survive,to be helpful

rows.mappingNote: New exact source form and reading.
rows.sourceNote: Intransitive survival/rescue, escape from damage and practical relief. Do not confuse with an inflected passive of 助ける; indirect request Vてくれると助かる is explicitly explained.

rows.mappingNote: New exact source form and reading; teach usual kana ただし alongside it.
rows.sourceNote: Conjunction introducing restriction, condition or exception. Distinguish 正しい and assess actual caveat/contrast senses, including ただ and もっとも; register and attachment alone do not settle a broad however label.

rows.mappingNote: New exact source form and reading; recognize usual kana たたむ.
rows.sourceNote: Source anchor folding clothes/umbrella; additional business closure and vacating. Do not equate putting clothes away with folding or daily door shutting with winding up a business. Reciprocal 畳 row uses native たた.む.

rows.mappingNote: New exact source form and primary reading たちどまる.
rows.sourceNote: Intransitive halt/pause in one's tracks; native compound 立ちたち plus voiced どまる. Other spellings are search-only; pinned たちとまる has outdated-kana flag, not an equally recommended pronunciation. Public recognition of that reading does not erase the pinned flag.

source.waller_definition: at once,in a moment,suddenly,all at once

rows.mappingNote: New exact kana source form and reading.
rows.sourceNote: Immediate result and sudden occurrence; recognize spelling 忽ち. Do not require simultaneity of a group or claim an absolute speed/surprise compartment. 一瞬's nominal interval and 一斉's grouping are not automatically identical to an adverb merely through all at once wording.

source.waller_definition: to erect,to be erected,to be built

rows.mappingNote: New exact source spelling and reading; distinct from existing 立つ and 経つ.
rows.sourceNote: Intransitive be built/erected; correct misleading transitive to erect source gloss without changing raw fields. Structure takes が, location に; contrast 建てる explicitly. Same-reading identities are not reuses.

source.waller_definition: to depart (on a plane, train, etc.)

rows.mappingNote: New exact source spelling and reading; preserve separate entry 2857436.
rows.sourceNote: Journey departure, intransitive, with place left marked を and transport で. Pinned cross-reference explicitly recognizes 立つ entry1597040 sense5; old posture-focused title does not disprove that ordinary departure sense. Assess other departure labels directly.

rows.mappingNote: New exact source form and reading.
rows.sourceNote: Derailment and digression/deviation; intransitive suru. ダツ+セン becomes だっせん. Missing 脱 card does not remove 脱 from metadata. Add reciprocal 線 reading-row/Common words links.

rows.mappingNote: New exact source form and reading.
rows.sourceNote: Reasonable/appropriate/valid evaluation. Focus practical な-adjective construction; recognize dictionary noun/suru classification without invented passive or conjugation. Assess amount/degree uses and old reasonable sense of もっとも/相当 rather than only their titles.

source.waller_definition: to compare,to liken,to speak figuratively,to illustrate,to use a simile

rows.mappingNote: New exact source form and reading; recognize 喩える and 譬える.
rows.sourceNote: Transitive ichidan AをBに例える, liken A to B. Distinguish metaphor from all comparison without pretending broad compare quiz labels are necessarily disjoint. Written boundary 例たと+える differs from conjugation stemたとえ.

rows.mappingNote: New exact source form and reading.
rows.sourceNote: Reliable/reassuring and hopeful/promising i-adjective. 頼母しい is search-only, not recommended equivalent practice. Assess ordinary dependable person use of しっかり and reliable senses of 確か/確実 without equating all trust topics.

rows.mappingNote: New exact source form and reading; not reuse of 度 or 旅.
rows.sourceNote: Traditional split-toe socks; rare 単皮 remains qualified. Teach whole 足袋たび; no invented 足た or 袋び individual readings. Public exact 足袋/単皮たび heading verifies word/reading and split-toe description; failed/irrelevant Kanjipedia lookups verify nothing. Add qualified whole-word reciprocal 袋 row.

rows.mappingNote: New exact source form and reading.
rows.sourceNote: Double source anchor plus double bed/room, clothing, cloth and sports uses. Rare identity-label sense7 is not practical selected teaching. ダッブル is search-only; distinguish ダブる. 倍 overlaps directly; ベッド assessed for documented secondary bed sense, not copied through a room-topic network.

rows.mappingNote: New exact kana source form and reading; recognize 騙す.
rows.sourceNote: Transitive deception/tricking source anchor plus separately documented coaxing/soothing. Passiveだまされる is distinguished. No automatic fraud/lying-topic exclusion network; rare 欺す/瞞す are not promoted.

rows.mappingNote: New exact source form and reading; teach usual kana たまる.
rows.sourceNote: Intransitive accumulation with が; contrast transitive 溜める. Pinned 貯まる2036940 is separate, but public dictionary recognizes financial accumulation under 溜まる too. Do not invent absolute money/nonmoney compartments or copy every 蓄える guard.

rows.mappingNote: New exact source form and reading; retain raw erroneous gloss unchanged.
rows.sourceNote: Correct raw dumb to teaching dam using exact pinned1077140 and inspected Digital Daijisen ダム[dam] heading. Mixed Dam/Damme names and old Japanese verb headings are unrelated, not corroborating senses.

rows.mappingNote: Normalize source 溜息 to recognized ため息; explicitly teach raw source spelling and reading.
rows.sourceNote: Recognize ため息/溜息/溜め息, all unrestricted ためいき. Pinned spelling priorities are not frequency measurements. Noun sigh; teachをつく andが出る, emotions not limited to disappointment. Primary written kanji array is [息]; old はあ/ほっと explicitly teach sigh uses, while generic breathing topic alone is not a guard.

rows.mappingNote: New exact kana source form and reading.
rows.sourceNote: Usually kana; 躊躇う reading has gikun/jukujikun flag. Explain both objectless and Vのをためらう constructions, not objectless-only. 迷う overlaps in indecision; physical stopping topic alone does not equate hesitation with 立ち止まる.

rows.mappingNote: New exact source form and reading; teach kana ためる alongside it.
rows.sourceNote: Transitive ichidan accumulation/storage source anchor plus unpaid obligation sense2. 家賃をためる means falling behind, not saving rent money. Distinguish intransitive 溜まる and separately pinned 貯める1427160 without absolute spelling bans.

rows.mappingNote: New exact kana source form and reading.
rows.sourceNote: Neutral modern teaching uses sloppy/undisciplined, additional evaluative weakness/lack of resolve; do not reproduce demeaning outdated English from raw source. Search-only だらし無い is not promoted. Assess exact messy/careless/weak labels rather than every topic-related habit.

quizGuardRationale: Author hypotheses, not independent findings or actual runtime draws. Direct symmetric/nontransitive judgments require actual labels and ordinary senses, including old secondary senses. Inspect excesses too; no topic-only/homophone-only/transitive closure rule.
助かる assesses rescue/survival and practical-help labels; transitivity alone does not always disambiguate short English glosses. 但し assesses actual caveat/contrast uses, including ただ and もっとも.

畳む assesses fold and business-close labels, not generic storage. 立ち止まる assesses stop/halt, not rest/cancel merely through a topic. たちまち assesses immediate and sudden labels, not 一斉 grouping or nominal 一瞬 interval from wording alone.

建つ assesses building-action labels; no guards with homophonous 発つ/立つ/経つ solely by reading. 発つ does assess 立つ's explicit journey-departure sense5 despite old posture-focused title, plus direct other departure labels.

脱線 assesses actual straying/digression, not every train/conversation topic. 妥当 assesses suitability/reasonableness/validity, including ordinary amount evaluation and secondary reasonable senses. 例える assesses broad comparison labels despite its metaphor focus.

頼もしい assesses reliable/dependable labels and しっかり's actual dependable-person use, not every trust or strength word. 足袋 assesses generic socks, not 草履/下駄 topic alone. ダブル assesses double and documented bed sense, not generic room solely through topic.

溜まる/溜める assess direct accumulation, gathering, saving and stockpiling senses, but do not copy all 蓄える development/beard guards. Unpaid rent is distinct from saving rent money; 貯 spellings do not prove absolute financial/nonfinancial boundaries.

ため息 assesses はあ/ほっと's actual sigh uses, not generic 息/呼吸/吐く breathing solely by category. ためらう assesses actual indecision with 迷う, not physical stopping alone. だらしない assesses messy/careless/weak labels by relevant sense, not general habits.
No new declarations for だます or ダム after bounded comparisons; no exhaustive quiz uniqueness or corpus judgment is claimed.

adjudications.decision: Accept eight direct edges: たちまち/すっと; 妥当/成立 and /適する; both 溜まる and 溜める with 重なる; ためらう/ぐずぐず; だらしない/ぐしゃぐしゃ and /だらだら. Actual full old bodies and complete pinned senses explicitly establish suddenness, validity, suitability, accumulation, hesitation and non-wet untidy/slovenly uses.

Accept 例える/例え for actual figurative comparison and たちまち/一瞬 for explicit rapid-result 一瞬で in the old body. These are actual English-label/construction judgments, not a universal same-kanji noun/verb rule.
Append 1404920 to 袋's final source list. It was already cited inline; low-impact consistency, not absent evidence.
Add 妥当/立つ: complete 1597040:13 explicitly teaches valid, logical and reasonable arguments. Independent of building-standing optional comparison; not a reviewer contribution.
Not adopted: 1597040:2 standing/situation differs from being built/erected. Homophony/shared building topic alone is insufficient.

Not adopted: complete 1341210 and actual article describe instant/point in time or momentary duration, without establishing the rapid-result construction seen in 一瞬で. Bounded decision, not absolute nonoverlap.

adjudications.decision: No expansion/removal established: reassuring dependability, relying on help and attributing benefit to a cause differ. Cautious observations are not mandatory guards or established excesses.

correctionEvidence.modelDiversity: Compare all sections. GPT contributes eight required pairs; Claude two different required pairs plus low-impact citation consistency. No shared required pair. Author contributes one more. Equal access but unequal actual depth: GPT 116 old bodies/all ten complete family renderings; Claude three old bodies/targeted family records. Useful complementary coverage, not controlled bias reduction or model ranking.
correctionEvidence.limits: Author reconciliation, not reviewer confirmation.
